title: [교외행사] 【오사카 대학 주최】Study in Japan Online University Fair 2024
contentHtml:
오사카 대학에서는 3월 1일부터 3월 2일까지 온라인 유학 박람회를 개최하며, 해당 행사에는 일본 전역의 17개 대학이 동시에 참가합니다. 
관심있는 학생들의 많은 참가 바라며, 구체적인 정보는 아래의 영문 공지를 참고 바랍니다. 


We are thrilled to extend an invitation to you and your students to participate in the Study in Japan Online University Fair 2024, which will be hosted by Osaka University.

This virtual event will provide a valuable platform for representatives from various Japanese universities to showcase their diverse range of programs, admission processes, scholarship opportunities, as well as insights into students' lives in Japan. It will be an enriching experience for all participants, offering valuable information and resources for those considering studying or researching in Japan.

★Key Details:
Event: Study in Japan Online University Fair 2024
Host: Osaka University
Participating Organizations: 17 Universities from 5 regions of Japan
Date & Time: March 1, 2024 (Friday), 15:00~17:50 (UTC+9, JST)
              March 2, 2024 (Saturday), 10:00~12:50 (UTC+9, JST)
Platform: Zoom Webinar

Registration for the event is now open, and we encourage you and your students to secure your spots by registering through the following link:
https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_JAZNq6BFR8ykNchD0D55bA 

For further information and updates regarding the fair, please visit the official event website: https://www.studyinjapan-jfiu.com/

We believe that this event will serve as an excellent opportunity for your students to gain valuable insights into the educational landscape in Japan and explore the myriad opportunities available for academic and personal growth.

We look forward to your participation!

Warm regards,
Center for Global Initiatives  
Osaka University
